title.narrative: Shifting power: Voices for Climate Action

description.narrative: The Alternative Youth and Declares Kenya are conducting a preparatory study to evaluate youth awareness in West Pokot County, Kenya, about climate change and its link to natural disasters, identifying barriers to their participation in climate policies. The pilot project targets youths aged 15 to 35, focusing on climate change mitigation, resilience, and adaptation advocacy. It aims to empower young individuals with climate education and leadership skills, enhance organizational capacity through volunteer engagement, and promote gender equality by including marginalized voices in decision-making. Key activities include workshops with local and Danish volunteers, community projects, media engagement, and policy advocacy. Expected outcomes include a youth empowerment workshop format, mobilization of 25 youth volunteers, and increased youth inclusion in climate policies. This holistic approach ensures sustainable outcomes, fostering a strong volunteer culture and contributing to climate-resilient, gender-equal communities in West Pokot County in Kenya .
